description: Check a scenario file against the simulation workspace this credential is connected to without running it: every problem in the file and every item, supplier, warehouse or purchase-order quantity the workspace does not have, plus a plain-language reading of each step. ready=true means run_simulation_scenario will accept it. Use it after writing or editing a file, and show the user the steps before running. Changes nothing.

scenario.description: The whole scenario file as JSON text (format "spark.scenario", version 1).

name: check_simulation_scenario
title: Check Simulation Scenario
